LanguageData.WFL_S_LogEvents: Log family events to the dev log
LanguageData.WFL_S_LogEventsTip: Writes one line per family change (births, deaths, partnerships, moves) to the log. Useful when reporting a problem.
LanguageData.WFL_Chron_RecordsBegan: The colony began keeping family records.
LanguageData.WFL_Chron_LineageFounded: {0} became the founder of the {1} family.
LanguageData.WFL_NoFamilies: No family records yet. They appear as soon as the colony has people with known relatives.
LanguageData.WFL_NoHouseholds: Nobody from this family lives in the colony right now.
LanguageData.WFL_HouseholdsHelp: A household is the people who live together. Partners who move in together form a new household, children stay with their parents, and adult children stay until they pair up. Use Move to change it yourself.
LanguageData.WFL_S_GriefTip: When someone dies, relatives who were closely attached get an extra, small and temporary mood penalty on top of the game's own. The closer they were, the deeper it goes. Turn off to leave grief entirely to the base game.
LanguageData.WFL_S_ActivitiesTip: Relatives spend time together during joy time, children are read to before bed, and relatives who eat together feel it. These take the place of other recreation; they never interrupt work, a player order, or an emergency. Turn off to remove all of it.
LanguageData.WFL_S_Hours: Family time target per day: {0} hours
LanguageData.WFL_S_HoursTip: A soft limit. Once someone has had this much family time today they stop starting new family activities until tomorrow. An activity already in progress is never cut short.
LanguageData.WFL_S_StoriesTip: In the hour before a child's bedtime, the parent with the best Social skill who is free reads to them. With a book the child learns from it; without one the parent teaches something they know, at a lower rate.
LanguageData.WFL_S_MealsTip: Relatives who eat in the same room at about the same time grow closer and get a small mood lift. It does not change where or when anyone eats.
LanguageData.WFL_LeftOut: The others do not seem very attached to: {0}
LanguageData.WFL_CohesionHelp: Closeness is a summary of how attached and trusting the people in a household are, less any tension between them. Individuals can feel differently from the household as a whole.
LanguageData.WFL_RelHelp: How this person feels about each of their relatives. It sits alongside the game's own opinion and never replaces it. Hover a row for the numbers.
LanguageData.WFL_S_Dates: Dates for partners (with a sitter for the children)
LanguageData.WFL_S_DatesTip: Partners sometimes spend an hour alone together. If children are at home, a trusted relative or friend minds them.
LanguageData.WFL_S_TeachingTip: An older relative who is clearly better at a skill may teach a younger one during family time.
LanguageData.WFL_S_BabyBondingTip: Parents hold, sing to and play with their babies.
LanguageData.WFL_S_BedsideTip: Relatives who are close to someone unwell may sit with them.
LanguageData.WFL_S_TraditionsTip: Families take up traditions from what they value, and sometimes hold gatherings for them, for a coming of age, or to remember someone.
LanguageData.WFL_S_ConflictsTip: Tension that lasts can become a rift between relatives. Rifts can be mended with time together.
LanguageData.WFL_S_RivalryTip: A child who is given far less attention than a sibling may resent the sibling.
LanguageData.WFL_S_HealthTip: Couples who have drifted apart are more likely to break up; steady couples are less likely to.
LanguageData.WFL_S_AffairsTip: Off by default. A partnered colonist whose relationship is in real crisis may start a romance with someone else.
LanguageData.WFL_S_StrictTip: Partnered colonists never start romances with others.
LanguageData.WFL_Msg_TraditionAdopted: The {0} family has taken up a tradition: {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_Gathering_Text_tradition: {0} is bringing the family together for a tradition.
LanguageData.WFL_Gathering_Text_comingofage: {0} is bringing the family together to celebrate {1} becoming an adult.
LanguageData.WFL_Gathering_Text_memorial: {0} is gathering the family to remember {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_Chron_Reunion: {0} came back after a long time away.
LanguageData.WFL_Chron_TraditionAdopted: The {0} family took up a tradition: {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_Chron_TraditionAbandoned: The {0} family let go of a tradition: {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_NoValues: No clear family values yet. They form from the character of the people in the family, and from what they live through.
LanguageData.WFL_CultureHelp: Values follow the character of the family's members and move slowly. Shared events reinforce them.
LanguageData.WFL_TraditionsHelp: A family takes up a tradition when it values what the tradition is about. You can mute one, or ask for it to be held now.
LanguageData.WFL_NoTraditions: This family has no traditions yet. They appear on their own once its values are clear and enough of the family is in the colony.
LanguageData.WFL_Why_Friction: forced company they did not enjoy
LanguageData.WFL_Msg_BondDeepened: {0} has grown much closer to {1}, from {2}.
LanguageData.WFL_S_BondMessages: Tell me when relationships change noticeably
LanguageData.WFL_S_BondMessagesTip: A short message when someone grows much closer to, or drifts from, a relative, with the reason.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeClick: Click to compare closeness with everyone.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeLegend: The coloured bar on a person is the household they live in. Dim boxes are people who are elsewhere or who have died.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeLinkFormer: Former partners: the partnership ended (divorced or separated).
LanguageData.WFL_TreeLegendLinks: A pink bar joins partners; a broken red bar joins former partners. A child hangs from the point between its own two parents, and a faint line links a parent who is drawn apart. Blue text marks step-parents and step-children.
LanguageData.WFL_Chron_FamiliesJoined: {0} and {1} became partners, joining the {2} and {3} families.
LanguageData.WFL_Chron_StepFamily: {0} and {1} became partners and formed a step-family{2}.
LanguageData.WFL_Msg_FamiliesJoined: {0} and {1} are now partners, joining the {2} and {3} families.
LanguageData.WFL_ExportRecordsTip: Writes who is related to whom, as the mod has recorded it, to a text file. Useful for checking a tree that looks wrong.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeFocusHelp: Click a person to see how close everyone else is to them. Double-click to find someone in the colony.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeFocusing: Showing how close everyone is to {0}: the green bar fills as they grow closer. Click {0} again to hide it, or click anyone else to compare with them.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeFeels: {0} feels {2} attached to {1}, with {3} trust and {4} tension.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeNoBond: No bond is recorded between {0} and {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_TreeDoubleClick: Double-click to find them in the colony.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneHelp: A family area marks its preferred home. Pawns still follow your allowed areas. Put shelves inside it or extend its linked allowed area over suitable stockpiles to let the family store supplies there.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneNone: No family has been given this zone yet.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneCurrent: Home: {0}. {2} family members in the colony. Player movement restrictions remain independent.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneChoose: Use a family zone already painted
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneRemove: Take this family out of its zone
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneTooMany: The game allows only a few allowed areas. Delete one you do not use, or choose an existing area.
LanguageData.WFL_FamilyZoneDesc: Paint a zone for one family. Choose the family on the zone afterwards and every member is kept to it. Use Delete Zone to shrink or remove it.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneChooseFamilyDesc: Choose which family this zone belongs to. Everyone in that family, including children born later, stays inside it.
LanguageData.WFL_Mem_Bond: {0} and {1} had a moment that mattered.
LanguageData.WFL_Mem_Rupture: {0} and {1} had a falling out that was not forgotten.
LanguageData.WFL_S_SocialEventsTip: People talk, comfort, quarrel, teach and make up, in family, with friends, and between families, when their circumstances give them reason to. Turn off to stop them altogether.
LanguageData.WFL_S_EventsIndividualTip: Moments between people who are not family. They never involve their families unless something serious happens.
LanguageData.WFL_S_EventsInterTip: Moments that can change how two families stand with each other.
LanguageData.WFL_S_EventsSharedTip: Moments that happen while people are already playing, working or eating together.
LanguageData.WFL_S_EventFrequencyTip: A multiplier on how often people reach out to each other. Nobody has more than three meaningful moments a day, whatever this is set to.
LanguageData.WFL_S_EventNoticesTip: Routine moments are never announced; they are in the history. This sets which of the rest you are told about.
LanguageData.WFL_S_EventNotices_1: Tell me about moments that matter
LanguageData.WFL_S_EventNotices_2: Tell me about every notable moment
LanguageData.WFL_Gathering_Report_reconciliation: at a gathering to mend things.
LanguageData.WFL_Gathering_Text_reconciliation: {0} is inviting two families to sit down together to put right what has come between them, and has asked {1} to come.
LanguageData.WFL_Moments_Standing: How this family stands with others
LanguageData.WFL_Moments_NoTies: This family has not yet had a meaningful moment with another family.
LanguageData.WFL_Moments_TieNote: This comes from what has happened between particular people and families, not from averaging everyone's feelings. Individuals can feel quite differently from how their families stand.
LanguageData.WFL_TieCauseMany: Several smaller things have added up.
LanguageData.WFL_TieMending: A gathering to mend things has been asked for.
LanguageData.WFL_Moments_NoPromises: No promises are being kept track of.
LanguageData.WFL_PromiseLine_0: {0} has promised {1} some time together by {2}.
LanguageData.WFL_PromiseLine_2: {0} did not keep their promise to {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_Moments_None: No moments between these people have been recorded yet.
LanguageData.WFL_S_ZonesWork: Family zones only apply outside work hours
LanguageData.WFL_S_ZonesWorkTip: During work (and anything) time a family's members are free to go where the work is; the zone holds them for sleep and recreation. Turn off to keep them in the zone at all times (they will only do work inside it).
LanguageData.WFL_S_FamilyDoors: Outsiders knock before entering a family zone
LanguageData.WFL_S_FamilyDoorsTip: A family zone is a home. Colonists from outside the family do not wander into it or take work inside it; when they would, they go to the edge and knock, an adult of the family comes to let them in, and if nobody comes they give up and do something else. Family members, someone who sleeps there, and orders you give are not affected. Turn off to let everyone go anywhere.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneBedsDealt: {0} people in {1} were given a bed in the new home.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneBedsNone: No beds in this zone could be shared out: none is free of other owners, or nobody in the family can use them.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneDealBedsConfirm: Take back the beds in this zone that were given out to {0} and share them out again? Beds you gave to someone yourself since, beds locked in Better Beds, and beds owned by people outside the family stay as they are.
LanguageData.WFL_ZoneDealBedsDesc: Unassign the family's beds in this zone and give them out again: couples first, to the most comfortable place they can sleep together, then the children, then everyone else, to the most comfortable beds left. Any kind of bed. Beds owned by anyone outside the family stay as they are.
